## Data anomoly edits

```{r}

getwd()
# This starts looking from your Project folder instead of the C: drive
people_counter_processed <- read.csv("Data/Processed/PowerBI/EcoCounter_PowerBI_Main2.csv", header = TRUE)




```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Oceanside Trail Annual Visitation Analysis
# =============================================================================
# Assumes: people_counter_processed is already loaded in your R environment
# Columns: CounterID, Date, Hour, Year, Month, Day, PedestrianIn, 
#          PedestrianOut, TotalCount
# =============================================================================
#install.packages(c("forecast", "zoo", "scales"))
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)   # for STL decomposition + imputation
library(zoo)        # for rolling means / na.approx fallback

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
```


```{r}
# 0. SETUP & INITIAL PEEK
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
df <- people_counter_processed

# Ensure Date is Date type
df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date)

cat("=== Data Overview ===\n")
cat("Date range:", format(min(df$Date)), "to", format(max(df$Date)), "\n")
cat("CounterIDs present:\n")
print(table(df$CounterID))
cat("Total rows:", nrow(df), "\n\n")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. FILTER TO TARGET COUNTERS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_counters <- c("Oceanside Trail 1", "Tidepool Lot 1")

df_target <- df %>%
  filter(CounterID %in% target_counters)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. AGGREGATE TO DAILY TOTALS (per CounterID)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# People = TotalCount / 2 (each person triggers in + out)
daily <- df_target %>%
  group_by(CounterID, Date, Year, Month, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    DailyPedestriansIn  = sum(PedestriansIn,  na.rm = TRUE),
    DailyPedestriansOut = sum(PedestriansOut, na.rm = TRUE),
    DailyCombinedCount  = sum(CombinedCount,  na.rm = TRUE),
    HourlyRecords       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # People = (In + Out) / 2  — one full trip = one entry + one exit
    DailyPeople = (DailyPedestriansIn + DailyPedestriansOut) / 2
  )

cat("=== Daily Summary (first 6 rows per counter) ===\n")
print(daily %>% group_by(CounterID) %>% slice_head(n = 6))

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. FLAG SUSPICIOUS DAYS (DailyPeople > 2500)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
suspicious_thresholds <- c(
  "Oceanside Trail 1" = 1000,
  "Tidepool Lot 1"    = 1750
)

daily <- daily %>%
  mutate(
    Threshold  = suspicious_thresholds[CounterID],
    Suspicious = DailyPeople > Threshold
  )
 
suspicious_days <- daily %>% filter(Suspicious)
 
cat("\n=== Suspicious Days (Oceanside Trail 1 > 1000, Tidepool Lot 1 > 1750) ===\n")
if (nrow(suspicious_days) == 0) {
  cat("No suspicious days found.\n")
} else {
  print(suspicious_days %>% select(CounterID, Date, DailyPeople))
  cat("Total suspicious day-records flagged:", nrow(suspicious_days), "\n")
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. REMOVE SUSPICIOUS DAYS (set to NA for imputation)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_clean <- daily %>%
  mutate(DailyPeople_clean = if_else(Suspicious, NA_real_, DailyPeople))
 
# Flag known counter breakdown: Tidepool Lot 1 offline 2025-12-15 to 2026-01-04
# Counter recorded 0s during this period (not NA), so we force them to NA
# so the STL imputation treats the whole window as a gap to fill.
breakdown_start <- as.Date("2025-12-15")
breakdown_end   <- as.Date("2026-01-04")
 
daily_clean <- daily_clean %>%
  mutate(
    DailyPeople_clean = if_else(
      CounterID == "Tidepool Lot 1" &
        Date >= breakdown_start & Date <= breakdown_end,
      NA_real_,          # overwrite both 0s and any existing NAs
      DailyPeople_clean
    )
  )
 
breakdown_days <- sum(
  daily_clean$CounterID == "Tidepool Lot 1" &
  daily_clean$Date >= breakdown_start &
  daily_clean$Date <= breakdown_end
)
cat("Tidepool Lot 1 breakdown days forced to NA:", breakdown_days, "\n")
cat("Total days flagged as NA for imputation (suspicious + breakdown):",
    sum(is.na(daily_clean$DailyPeople_clean)), "\n\n")
 
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 5. TIME SERIES IMPUTATION & FORECASTING PER COUNTER
#    - Tidepool Lot 1:    observed 2025-05-07 to 2026-05-07 (fill any gaps)
#    - Oceanside Trail 1: observed from 2025-06-12, forecast forward to 2026-06-12
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
impute_and_forecast <- function(counter_data, counter_name,
                                annual_start, annual_end) {
 
  cat("--- Processing:", counter_name, "---\n")
  cat("  Annual window:", format(annual_start), "to", format(annual_end), "\n")
 
  # Build full date spine for the observed data range
  obs_start  <- min(counter_data$Date)
  obs_end    <- max(counter_data$Date)
  full_dates <- data.frame(Date = seq(obs_start, obs_end, by = "day"))
 
  merged <- full_dates %>%
    left_join(counter_data %>% select(Date, DailyPeople_clean, Suspicious),
              by = "Date")
 
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(merged$DailyPeople_clean))
  cat("  Observed days:", nrow(merged), "| Missing/flagged:", n_missing, "\n")
 
  # --- Impute internal gaps using STL (weekly seasonality) ---
  ts_obs        <- ts(merged$DailyPeople_clean, frequency = 7)
  imputed_values <- pmax(as.numeric(na.interp(ts_obs)), 0)
 
  merged$DailyPeople_imputed <- imputed_values
  merged$Imputed             <- is.na(merged$DailyPeople_clean)
  merged$Forecasted          <- FALSE
  merged$CounterID           <- counter_name
 
  # --- Forecast future dates if annual_end extends beyond observed data ---
  if (annual_end > obs_end) {
 
    n_forecast <- as.integer(annual_end - obs_end)
    cat("  Forecasting", n_forecast, "days beyond", format(obs_end), "\n")
 
    # Fit ETS model on imputed series with weekly seasonality
    ts_fit <- ts(merged$DailyPeople_imputed, frequency = 7)
    fit    <- ets(ts_fit)
    fc     <- forecast(fit, h = n_forecast)
 
    future_dates <- seq(obs_end + 1, annual_end, by = "day")
    future_df <- data.frame(
      Date                = future_dates,
      DailyPeople_clean   = NA_real_,
      Suspicious          = FALSE,
      DailyPeople_imputed = pmax(as.numeric(fc$mean), 0),
      Imputed             = FALSE,
      Forecasted          = TRUE,
      CounterID           = counter_name
    )
 
    merged <- bind_rows(merged, future_df)
  }
 
  # --- Trim to the exact annual window ---
  merged <- merged %>%
    filter(Date >= annual_start & Date <= annual_end)
 
  cat("  Days in annual window:", nrow(merged),
      "| Forecasted:", sum(merged$Forecasted), "\n\n")
 
  return(merged)
}
 
# --- Run per counter with their specific annual windows ---
 
tidepool_daily <- impute_and_forecast(
  counter_data = daily_clean %>% filter(CounterID == "Tidepool Lot 1"),
  counter_name = "Tidepool Lot 1",
  annual_start = as.Date("2025-05-07"),
  annual_end   = as.Date("2026-06-12")
)
 
oceanside_daily <- impute_and_forecast(
  counter_data = daily_clean %>% filter(CounterID == "Oceanside Trail 1"),
  counter_name = "Oceanside Trail 1",
  annual_start = as.Date("2025-06-12"),
  annual_end   = as.Date("2026-06-12")
)
 
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. ANNUAL TOTALS TABLE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
annual_totals <- bind_rows(
  tidepool_daily %>% summarise(
    CounterID      = "Tidepool Lot 1",
    AnnualStart    = as.Date("2025-05-07"),
    AnnualEnd      = as.Date("2026-06-12"),
    TotalDays      = n(),
    DaysObserved   = sum(!Imputed & !Forecasted),
    DaysImputed    = sum(Imputed),
    DaysForecasted = sum(Forecasted),
    AnnualPeople   = round(sum(DailyPeople_imputed, na.rm = TRUE))
  ),
  oceanside_daily %>% summarise(
    CounterID      = "Oceanside Trail 1",
    AnnualStart    = as.Date("2025-06-12"),
    AnnualEnd      = as.Date("2026-06-11"),
    TotalDays      = n(),
    DaysObserved   = sum(!Imputed & !Forecasted),
    DaysImputed    = sum(Imputed),
    DaysForecasted = sum(Forecasted),
    AnnualPeople   = round(sum(DailyPeople_imputed, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    PctImputed    = round(100 * DaysImputed    / TotalDays, 1),
    PctForecasted = round(100 * DaysForecasted / TotalDays, 1)
  )
 
cat("=== ANNUAL TRAIL USAGE SUMMARY ===\n")
print(annual_totals)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. LINE CHART — Daily visitors by data type, both counters on one plot
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
# Combine both counters and tag each day's data type
plot_data <- bind_rows(tidepool_daily, oceanside_daily) %>%
  mutate(
    DataType = case_when(
      Forecasted ~ "Forecasted",
      Imputed    ~ "Imputed",
      TRUE       ~ "Observed"
    ),
    DataType = factor(DataType, levels = c("Observed", "Imputed", "Forecasted"))
  )
 
# Colour palette
type_colours <- c(
  "Observed"   = "#2C7BB6",
  "Imputed"    = "#F4A400",
  "Forecasted" = "#D7191C"
)
 
p_line <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Date, y = DailyPeople_imputed, group = CounterID)) +
  # Grey backbone line for continuity
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.35, colour = "grey70") +
  # Coloured points by data type
  geom_point(aes(colour = DataType), size = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = type_colours, name = "Data Type") +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b '%y",
    expand      = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA)) +
  facet_wrap(~CounterID, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title    = "Daily Trail Visitors — Oceanside Trail 1 & Tidepool Lot 1",
    subtitle = "Blue = observed  |  Orange = imputed (gap-filled)  |  Red = forecasted",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Daily Visitors"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "top",
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 9)
  )
 
print(p_line)
```
